label: GO, end of episode (low value), after a rewarded rare a2->S1 trial, repeating a2
explanation: Fires only at GO steps, and only in the last ~10 trials of an episode (ep_trial >= 90; 97% of activations are in trials 90-99), where the value head is low (< 5.2; 99.8% of mass). The predicate uses value as the observed stand-in for being near the end of the episode. Within that window it fires when the previous trial was a2 -> S1 (rare) and rewarded, and the agent is about to choose a2 again: a model-free style stay after a rare reward, which is the opposite of the model-based switch. The upcoming choice is the model own policy (model_act), so no future variable is used. Never fires at D1/D2 or when the previous trial was unrewarded, and almost never when a1 is chosen. The strongest activations (top quartile 95% covered) come after a run of rare a2->S1 trials ending in a reward. Missed activations are mostly weak ones at GO late in the episode after other a2 histories, e.g. common-rewarded a2. Dev: P 0.80, R 0.59, F1 0.68, mass recall 0.88.
